text.formatted: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.
text.plain: The planetar knows if it hears a lie.

text.formatted: If the planetar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.
text.plain: If the planetar dies outside Mount Celestia, its body disappears, and it gains a new body instantly, reviving with all its Hit Points somewhere in Mount Celestia.

text.formatted: The planetar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.
text.plain: The planetar has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

text.formatted: The planetar makes three Radiant Sword attacks or uses Holy Burst twice.
text.plain: The planetar makes three Radiant Sword attacks or uses Holy Burst twice.

text.formatted: _Melee Attack Roll:_ +12, reach 10 ft. _Hit:_ 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.
text.plain: Melee Attack Roll: +12, reach 10 ft. Hit: 14 (2d6 + 7) Slashing damage plus 18 (4d8) Radiant damage.

text.formatted: _Dexterity Saving Throw:_ DC 20, each enemy in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the planetar can see within 120 feet. _Failure:_ 24 (7d6) Radiant damage. _Success:_ Half damage.
text.plain: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC 20, each enemy in a 20-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point the planetar can see within 120 feet. Failure: 24 (7d6) Radiant damage. Success: Half damage.

text.formatted:
The planetar casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as spellcasting ability (spell save DC 20):

- **At Will:** Detect Evil and Good
- **1/Day Each:** Commune, Control Weather, Dispel Evil and Good, Raise Dead
text.plain:

text.formatted: The planetar casts Cure Wounds, Invisibility, Lesser Restoration, or Remove Curse, using the same spellcasting ability as Spellcasting.
